Title: Current Validation Baseline
Content: The active validation baseline should be tracked under this stable ID rather than in a count-anchored memory key. As of 2026-05-25, `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj --no-build --list-tests --verbosity normal` listed 297 tests. Repository KB-health checks on the same date also passed for `Scripts/Test-PageLinks.ps1`, `Scripts/Test-PagePathLiterals.ps1`, `Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1`, and a full JSON parse pass over `Data/Memories/**/*.json` with 0 parse errors across 54 memory records. Use `Scripts/Validate-Repo.ps1` as the normal entrypoint, then use the focused page or task validators when only one knowledge-base surface changes. If the listed test count changes again, update this content and supporting evidence without changing the memory ID.
